user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Content crawled for training OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited based on specific user requests; not automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user queries in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to enhance search response relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed for search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Builds Google search indexes and performs analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search including Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google products and features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search features presenting images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-Image or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for Google Search and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-Video or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-News or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls surfaces for Google Shopping.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console; does not affect Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler used by product teams for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible site content; does not affect any specific Google product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents; has no effect on Google Search or other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training and grounding for Gemini models and Vertex AI.
user_agents.scope: Gemini models training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple ecosystem and crawls web data.
user_agents.scope: General web crawling and rendering across websites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent managing crawled data usage without crawling webpages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: facebookexternalhit/1.1
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared website or app content on Meta's family of apps.
user_agents.scope: Content shared on apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: meta-webindexer/1.1
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: meta-externalads/1.1
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products.
user_agents.scope: Web content for business and advertising products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: meta-externalagent/1.1
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content for foundation AI training or product improvement.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: meta-externalfetcher/1.1
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users and websites for agentic tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules due to user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for Bing search and Bing Chat generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Content across the web indexed for Bing search and AI experiences.
user_agents.opt_out: Block Bingbot in robots.txt or use NOCACHE or NOARCHIVE tags.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshots and previews for search results and services.
user_agents.scope: Web pages linked in search results and Microsoft services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow BingPreview user-agent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates rich previews for links shared in Microsoft apps.
user_agents.scope: URLs shared within Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and other Microsoft applications.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow MicrosoftPreview user-agent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling to improve products and train AI models across host websites.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow or disallow directives, rel=nofollow, and noarchive or noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for search experiences; excludes generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives for Amzn-SearchBot or search bots, and robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information to support user-initiated actions and Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web fetches for user queries; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives, though user-initiated actions may not follow all directives.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide an open copy of the Internet for research.
user_agents.scope: Sample and randomly selected subset of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow: / for CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
